sources.exact_use: Theorem ElementaryRationalPointOrbit and the two separate corollaries ReciprocalExponentDecisionWithoutOrbitImport and UniformFibreCoefficientField. Universal termination is proved in writing, not inferred from finite controls.

General implemented rational matrix point-orbit algorithm: Krylov quotient, zero-primary split, repeated-factor derivative, explicit nonintegral denominator bound, integral coefficient-growth certificate, and squarefree finite torsion period. The CLI executes34 exact control cases.

Milne ANT v3.08, Theorem7.38 printedp123/PDFp125 and Corollary7.40 printedp124/PDFp126, with Remark7.39: the p-adic absolute value extends to a finite separable extension and then an algebraic closure; ultrametricity remains. Actual retained statements inspected. The negative-root existence, denominator<=degree, and exponent bound O.6 are proved here; no ideal-factorization or Newton-polygon decision theorem is imported.

FixedCoordinateFibreClassification, in particular F.4-F.6, F.15-F.20: marked reciprocity, exact full-jet congruence, finite support, cyclic canonical polynomial and reconstruction. Algorithm Theorem ElementaryRationalPointOrbit itself does not depend on this source.

claim_dependency_separation.ElementaryRationalPointOrbit: Written O.2-O.10; only explicit external infrastructure is extension of the p-adic valuation. No dependency on a general Orbit decision theorem, Skolem theorem, old RationalOrbitReduction, or an imported complexity result.
claim_dependency_separation.ReciprocalExponentDecisionWithoutOrbitIm: ElementaryRationalPointOrbit plus retained fixed-coordinate conditions and the bounded canonical/finite-box/twist-box constructions. Uses complete coordinate vectors after rational restriction of scalars, including all jets.
claim_dependency_separation.UniformFibreCoefficientField: Retained F.15-F.16 finite support and reconstruction only. For u=P/Q, use squarefree part of Q(P+cQ), or Q at c=infinity, remove the factor x. One splitting field degree<= (2deg u)! works simultaneously for every positive odd height.

implemented_scope.input: Arbitrary rational square matrix of positive dimension and two rational vectors; noninvertible matrices and zero vectors included.
